settings.title: Who can register for a wholesale account?
settings.text: Wholesale accounts are available to verified businesses including retailers, boutiques, spas, online stores, interior designers, and gift shops. A valid ABN and resale details is required.

settings.title: What is the minimum order value?
settings.text: The minimum wholesale order value is AUD $350 (excluding GST and freight).

settings.title: How do I apply for a wholesale account?
settings.text: Simply register for wholesale access via our login/register page. Once approved, you’ll receive access to wholesale pricing and ordering.

settings.title: Do you offer custom packaging or labelling?
settings.text: Yes, we can provide tailored packaging solutions for wholesale orders. Please contact our team to discuss your requirements.

settings.title: How long will it take to dispatch my order?
settings.text: Our typical lead time is approximately 5-7 working days, depending on product type and order size.

settings.title: Do you supply internationally?
settings.text: Yes. We welcome international wholesale enquiries. Please contact our sales team with your region and requirements.

settings.title: What support do you offer wholesale partners?
settings.text: We provide catalogues, product images, scent descriptions, pricing support, and merchandising guidance to help you present our products to your customers.

settings.title: Need more help?
settings.text:
Our team is here to assist with wholesale enquiries, product details or private-label information.
Email: sales@pastelpines.com Phone: (02) 4577 7111

settings.title: Where do your shells and driftwood come from?
settings.text: Our products are responsibly sourced from trusted suppliers worldwide, with a focus on sustainability and ethical practices. For more details, please see our Responsible Sourcing page.

settings.title: Are the shells and driftwood natural or manufactured?
settings.text: All items are natural materials. Each piece is unique in shape, size, and colour, reflecting the beauty of nature. Learn more about what to expect on our Natural Variation page.

settings.title: Can I request specific sizes or shapes?
settings.text: We do our best to accommodate size preferences, but natural variation means exact specifications cannot always be guaranteed.

settings.title: What if my order looks different from the photos online?
settings.text: Because shells and driftwood are natural products, variations in colour, texture, and size are expected. This uniqueness is part of their charm. For more information, visit our Natural Variation page.

settings.title: How do you ensure ethical and sustainable sourcing?
settings.text: We partner only with suppliers who meet our strict standards for environmental responsibility and fair trade. Full details are available on our Responsible Sourcing page.

settings.title: How are the shells processed?
settings.text:
Shells go through a multi-step cleaning and preparation process to ensure they’re safe, export-ready, and suitable for use in home décor and accessories:

  • Sorting & Washing: Shells are manually cleaned using water, soft brushes, and mild detergent to remove sand, mud, and organic debris.
  • Boiling (if needed): Some batches are boiled to sanitise, remove odour, and eliminate remaining organic material.
  • Sun-Drying: Natural heat helps sterilise the shells and prevents mould growth.
  • Surface Cleaning: Shells are scrubbed or brushed to smooth the surface. Some may be lightly sanded or polished, and sharp edges are trimmed for safety.
  • Finishing (when required): A mild hydrogen peroxide bath may be used to brighten shells. For items where natural patina is preferred, no whitening chemicals are applied.
  • Final Drying & Inspection: Shells are fully dried to prevent moisture buildup during shipping. Each batch is checked for cleanliness, uniformity, defects, and correct species to meet international standards.

settings.title: Why do we use driftwood?
settings.text: We use driftwood because it’s a sustainable, low-impact material. Instead of sourcing new timber, we repurpose wood that’s naturally washed ashore. This reduces deforestation, keeps beaches cleaner, and gives new use to materials that would otherwise go to waste. Driftwood is durable, unique.

settings.title: Why are some items unavailable?
settings.text: Availability is seasonal and subject to natural supply. Certain species may also be restricted by collection or import bans. We comply fully with these regulations to support marine conservation and ensure long-term viability of supply.

settings.title: Why do starfish sometimes have a strong smell?
settings.text: Starfish are porous and can retain a natural marine scent even after processing. If needed, we recommend airing them out or misting lightly with a room spray before display or repackaging.
